newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMAN LEAGUE MATCH PUT OFF FOR FOURTH TIME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMAN LEAGUE MATCH PUT OFF FOR FOURTH TIME.

text.p: A German first division soccer match between Hamburg side St Pauli and Bochum was called off for the fourth time on Tuesday, this time because of storms which damaged St Pauli's stands and were endangering fans.
The match had been carried over from before the winter break, when it had to be called off three times owing to an unplayable pitch.
A new date for the fixture was to be set on Wednesday.
